steps.formulation: CombSUM and CombMNZ add the similarity scores of several runs, CombMNZ weighted by the number of runs that found a document.
steps.quote: CombMNZ to provide higher weights to documents retrieved by multiple retrieval methods.

criticism.quote: CombMNZ multiplies the sum of the uncalibrated scores of individual system by the sum of a binary quantization of each rank.

steps.formulation: Reciprocal rank fusion sums 1 / (k + rank) over the rankings, with k = 60.
steps.quote: we came up with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to serve as a baseline.

criticism.quote: because RRF is a function of ranks, it disregards the distribution of scores and, as such, discards useful information.

steps.formulation: Convex combination of normalised lexical and semantic scores with one parameter alpha.
